description: Round-four held-out synthetic meetings for the variant robustness eval. Written blind to the Rust verifier and to earlier held-out rounds; not used by Rust tests. Settings, names, organisations and products are invented.

segments.speaker: Wren
segments.text: Logistics: sixty hackers have registered and fourteen mentors have signed up. The food budget is 1,800 dollars, and separately we plan to rent thirty extra monitors.

segments.speaker: Dario
segments.text: We agreed to reserve the atrium for the closing demos on the 22nd as long as the fire marshal signs off, and I'll order the name badges from Ellis by Monday.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: Ellis already emailed the badge proof this morning, so that part is done.

segments.speaker: Wren
segments.text: Sponsor round-up: Tobias told me he called both sponsors yesterday, and they have renewed.

segments.speaker: Dario
segments.text: Can I ask whether we should livestream the demos? That's only a question for now, not a task for anyone.

segments.speaker: Mei
segments.text: I'll draft the judging rubric by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Wren
segments.text: Logistics: we decided not to rent another building. As I said, the atrium should be enough.

segments.speaker: Odette
segments.text: Editor's desk: we'll send the autumn issue to the printer on the 9th unless the council notice arrives late.

segments.speaker: Linus
segments.text: Let me correct that: the printer moved our slot, so we send it on the 11th.

segments.speaker: Fen
segments.text: Ads: a quarter-page ad costs forty pounds, or twenty-five pounds for members of the traders' association. The full page stays at ninety pounds.

segments.speaker: Linus
segments.text: I won't publish the housing survey results until Fen has checked the numbers with the residents' group.

segments.speaker: Odette
segments.text: Ads: the garage renewal is already paid.

segments.speaker: Fen
segments.text: I'll collect the remaining ad payments by Friday, provided that Odette sends me the invoice list.

segments.speaker: Odette
segments.text: Fine. We decided not to add a puzzle page this issue.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: Dispatch review: I noticed that Dexter, our scheduling app, double-booked two crews on the Hartley Street job.

segments.speaker: Calla
segments.text: I'll move the Hartley Street job to Thursday. Actually, make that Friday, because the big van is in the shop on Thursday.

segments.speaker: Joss
segments.text: Boxes: large boxes are four pounds each, and three pounds each only on orders of fifty or more.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: We agreed to take on the piano move on June 9th only if Joss finds another trained lifter.

segments.speaker: Joss
segments.text: Nils told me he returned the rented dollies yesterday.

segments.speaker: Calla
segments.text: Once we cancel Dexter, I'll switch dispatch to the shared calendar.

segments.speaker: Bram
segments.text: Boxes: the supplier invoice is settled.

segments.speaker: Imogen
segments.text: Rota check: I can confirm that Rafe will cover the weekend emergency line starting Saturday until Tullia returns from leave.

segments.speaker: Rafe
segments.text: I won't sign off the new drug order until the stock count is finished.

segments.speaker: Tullia
segments.text: Could I suggest we move the dental clinic to Tuesdays? It's just a suggestion, nobody needs to act on it yet.

segments.speaker: Kofi
segments.text: I'll run the stock count on the 15th, after the vaccine delivery arrives.

segments.speaker: Imogen
segments.text: Rota check: we decided not to close the clinic on bank holidays.

segments.speaker: Tullia
segments.text: Kofi, the delivery got pushed back, so the count has to be on the 17th, not the 15th.

segments.speaker: Kofi
segments.text: Right, the 17th it is.

segments.speaker: Hester
segments.text: Treasurer's report: we have twelve raised beds and thirty-one members, and the tool budget for spring is 650 pounds.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: Plot fees stay at twenty pounds a year, but drop to ten pounds for anyone over seventy.

segments.speaker: Yusra
segments.text: We agreed to buy the new compost bins if the council grant comes through, and I'll measure the shed wall on Saturday.

segments.speaker: Hester
segments.text: Marguerite told us she already repaired the leaking water butt.

segments.speaker: Amos
segments.text: I'll post the work-day notice on March 3, once Hester confirms the date with the allotment office.

segments.speaker: Hester
segments.text: Treasurer's report: the insurance renewal is complete.

segments.speaker: Yusra
segments.text: I'm not going to order more woodchip this season.

segments.speaker: Saoirse
segments.text: Gala planning: I can confirm the pool is booked, and the Morris timing system came back from repair yesterday.

segments.speaker: Benedikt
segments.text: I'll print the heat sheets on Thursday, as long as Morris exports the entry list cleanly.

segments.speaker: Lowri
segments.text: Should we ask the county club to lend us officials? I'm only raising it, I'm not volunteering anyone.

segments.speaker: Kemal
segments.text: I'll recruit six timekeepers by the 19th. Wait, not the 19th, the 21st.

segments.speaker: Saoirse
segments.text: Gala planning: entry is eight pounds per swimmer, or five pounds per swimmer for club members, and spectators get in free.

segments.speaker: Benedikt
segments.text: We decided not to sell programmes this year, and I won't order medals until the entry count is final.

segments.speaker: Lowri
segments.text: I'll send the results to the league secretary by the 27th, after Benedikt has checked them.
